composition.rule: The exact P1348 contract and pinned oracle/adversary/adapter baseline are immutable inputs. P1349 replaces only their mixed result channel, X06/X15 scheduling and absence of bounded per-process supervision; all other P1348 obligations remain exact.
composition.inherited_chain: P1349 -> P1348 failed transport baseline -> P1347 -> P1346 -> P1345 FINAL

pairwise_disjointness: meta_result keys contain meta_status and never classification/blocker_code
classification_result keys contain classification and never meta_status/blocker_code
integration_blocker keys contain blocker_code and verdict and never meta_status/classification/reason_code
result_schemas.cross_domain_rejection: A schema discriminator, key, nested envelope or value from another domain is SCHEMA at the transport boundary and cannot be coerced, stripped or defaulted.

meta_allowlist.process_isolation: Each entry receives a new executor PID/pidfd/session/process group, registry, challenge, nonce, pipes, targets copy and /dev/shm case root. Complete destruction/reap precedes the next entry.
meta_allowlist.terminal_rule: Only these two exact internally observed blockers at these phases can be consumed into meta PASS after all postconditions. Every other blocker, including any mismatch or cleanup failure in these cases, is terminal and increments unexpected_integration_blockers.

supervisor_binding.child_barrier: Every descendant is born stopped or waits on a readiness barrier. Executor sends the exact registration record before release. Parent checks PPID ancestry, SID/PGID membership and /proc starttime, opens and retains pidfd, then sends one ACK. No ACK means the child must not continue.
normal_completion_predicate: executor terminates before supervisor deadline without parent signal
all registered descendants terminate and are reaped
timeout_sequence: freeze result interpretation and set blocker_code SUPERVISOR_TIMEOUT
pidfd_send_signal(SIGTERM) to every retained live pidfd
pidfd_send_signal(SIGKILL) and killpg(SIGKILL) for any survivor
waitid/waitpid or equivalent parent reap for every registered process within kill_and_reap_ns
verify ESRCH for group and no registered live pidfd
close all descriptors and remove per-case /dev/shm root
supervisor_binding.timeout_output: p1349-integration-blocker-r1/SUPERVISOR_TIMEOUT; terminal; no classification or score credit
supervisor_binding.no_authority_from_output: No PID, pidfd, PGID, SID, deadline, exit status or cleanup fact read from case stdout is authoritative.

checker_success_sequence: observe second PTRACE_EVENT_EXEC for same retained pidfd before the single EXIT event
terminate tracee and every registered descendant
executor and supervisor normal completion before 12000000000 ns
x14_binding.scored_predicate: All checker_success_sequence predicates and every supervisor normal_completion_predicate are true; supervisor sent no signal.
x14_binding.terminal_output: integration_blocker with the exact earliest blocker_code; SUPERVISOR_TIMEOUT when the outer deadline causes intervention; excluded from numerator and denominator

reason_and_blocker_precedence.meta_exception: The two allowlisted X06/X15 observations are evaluated only inside exercise_meta before a meta_result exists. They do not alter semantic reason precedence and cannot appear in exercise_focal.
reason_and_blocker_precedence.terminality: A control-plane blocker wins immediately and permanently over any partial or subsequently fabricated semantic record. No later evidence can reopen or score that case.

counting_binding.final_denominator_formula: 243 + number of exact valid P1349 classification variants frozen independently after this contract
counting_binding.inclusions: A case enters both classification accounting and its denominator only if it is an exact released valid negative and terminates normally with classification_result. It enters the numerator only for exact Violated and exact expected reason.
counting_binding.no_combined_counter: No aggregate passed/killed/total field may combine meta, classification, control or blocker domains.

preinvoke_checks: case_id belongs to exactly one domain
meta ID equals one allowlisted entry or focal ID is in exact_ids
fresh disposable executor and supervisor handshake complete
adapter_api_binding.meta_translation: Within exercise_meta only, the exact planned injected integration blocker plus exact postconditions is translated to PASS. FAIL carries only meta evidence; it is never a semantic classification.
adapter_api_binding.focal_transport: exercise_focal transports raw checker observations into the closed classification schema and propagates any exception/blocker to the terminal control channel. It cannot return meta_result or integration_blocker as classification_result.
adapter_api_binding.restoration: Operation-local captures precede patch installation; try/finally restoration and exact object-identity comparison precede any result write.
adapter_api_binding.forbidden: No expectation, verdict, reason, process fact, deadline, ptrace event or cleanup fact is adapter-authored.

dag_edges: contract spec + contract binding -> contract receipt
authority_and_artifact_binding.acyclicity: Every edge points from an already frozen whole-file SHA-256 to a later artifact. No artifact self-pins; no receipt pins a caller or delivery artifact that consumes that receipt; no predecessor consumes a successor.

root_formulas.contract_root_sha256: SHA-256(RFC8785(["p1349-contract-root-r1", step_p1349_sha256, step_p1348_sha256, p1348_blocker_sha256, p1348_contract_spec_sha256, p1348_contract_binding_sha256, p1348_contract_receipt_sha256, p1348_oracle_checker_sha256, p1348_adversary_suite_sha256, p1348_verifier_adapter_sha256, p1349_contract_spec_sha256, p1349_contract_binding_sha256]))
root_formulas.execution_authority_root_sha256: SHA-256(RFC8785(["p1349-execution-authority-root-r1", contract_root_sha256, oracle_checker_sha256, oracle_caller_sha256, oracle_authorship_receipt_sha256, adversary_suite_sha256, adversary_authorship_receipt_sha256, adapter_sha256, adapter_authorship_receipt_sha256]))

authority_and_artifact_binding.external_anchor: Verifier receives the delivery-receipt whole-file SHA-256 out of band, validates the closed schema and walks all predecessors before import or execution. Preseal receives the delivery SHA-256 out of band and never from an artifact it is deciding.
authority_and_artifact_binding.classification_owner: Only the independent verifier derives accepted classification and score from authenticated raw execution evidence. Contract, corpus, oracle expectations, adapter and receipts do not self-judge.

release_predicates.G05: X14 timely checker-owned Violated/PROBE_AUTHORITY and every supervisor variant exact, no blocker
release_predicates.G09: fresh isolated schedules and normalized projections exact
release_predicates.G10: score 1.0, zero regressions, unexpected blockers 0, transport Unknown 0, exactly one authenticated opaque Unknown

gate_order.stop_before_next: Any false predicate, timeout, blocker, survivor, mismatch, drift or cleanup uncertainty prevents all later gates.

forbidden_bindings: One result schema or API shared by meta and classification domains.
X06 or X15 in a focal denominator, numerator, classification vector or release count.
Any blocker outside the two exact planned internal meta observations treated as expected, Preserved, Violated, Unknown or pass.
Dangerous cases sharing an executor, registry, process group, pipe, target root or patch state.
Wall-clock deadlines, PID-only signaling, no pidfd, no session/process group, child continuation before registration ACK, or timeout without complete kill and reap.
X14 credited because the external supervisor, KeyboardInterrupt or a synthetic adapter action terminated it.
Combined meta/classification counts, blocker score credit or denominator removal after a case has begun.
Adapter-authored classification/reason/process evidence, oracle/adversary self-judgment, internal trust anchor or protected-input rewrite.
Full corpus, RED, productive candidate, 38-capsule implementation, L0/consumer change, final certificate or general-equivalence claim.

budget_and_stop.stop: Two revisions without causal gain, any unexpected blocker, meta below 2/2, any focal survivor or reason mismatch, score below 1.0, regression, timeout, process leak, protected drift, transport Unknown, static failure or scope expansion blocks P1349.

closed_metadata.rule: Exactly these top-level keys in this order. Result schemas, meta allowlist, process supervision, timing, X14 credit, reason/blocker precedence, counts, APIs, authority DAG, gates and budgets are closed. Duplicate/unknown keys, alternate values or reordered gates are invalid.
